g.text: When a door is shut to you
A refused teleport, portal or warp shows what you need and where to buy it. A player with no main server yet is offered the free choice instead.
Buy one of these and right-click it. Sold at the Spawn Market, next to the bank.
One choice, free, for ever. Your base goes there and you always have access.
Choose BSP-Forest as your main server?
